note: Public SHACKLE registry. Each claim is bound to an exact implementation, artifact, environment, fixture hashes, and stated scope; certification is not an absolute safety guarantee.

certification_entry_schema.binding_rule: Certification attaches only to the exact version, commit, artifact digest, environment/configuration, and fixture hashes recorded in the entry. Material changes require fresh verification.

reference_implementation.proves: This runtime defines the published fixtures.

independent_reproduction.proves: A named party independently reran the published profiles and reproduced the named fixture/test results.
independent_reproduction.never_proves: Certification, implementation security, or production enforcement unless separately tested and listed.

certification.proves: The identified implementation, version, immutable commit, artifact digest, environment/configuration, and exact fixture hashes passed every required officially published conformance and runtime-adversarial profile under the recorded reproducible procedure on the stated date. This is a scoped, time-bound security-assurance finding about the properties exercised by those tests, not an absolute guarantee. The repository owner may self-verify and publish; independent reproductions are invited after publication.
certification.never_proves: Absolute security or safety, absence of undiscovered vulnerabilities, hostile OS/kernel/hypervisor resistance, protection against arbitrary code already executing in-process, untested deployment or supply-chain security, legal outcome, warranty, or any attack class not explicitly listed in the tested profiles.

production_enforcement.proves: Reserved — no entries yet; requires separate deployment-specific custody evidence.
